instruction: Like all the songs and albums in my Spotify song and album library, respectively, that I have not liked yet.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) plus supervisor. The library contents and like status are unknown a priori, so the problem models a representative instance: three library songs (two not yet liked, one already liked) and two library albums (one not yet liked, one already liked). Knowledge gathering is modeled with nullary flags: show_song_library/show_album_library make the library membership known, show_liked_songs/show_liked_albums make the current like status known; like_song/like_album require both flags, require the item to be in the library, and forbid re-liking already-liked items (matching the evaluation: new likes only for library items, nothing updated/removed, everything in the library liked afterwards). Because STRIPS has no quantified goals, 'all unliked library items are liked' is encoded with discrete count objects: unliked-library-songs/albums start at the number of unliked items in :init and each like action decrements the counter via the static count-pred relation; the goal and the precondition of supervisor-complete-task are the counters reaching the domain constant zero, which entails (liked-song ...) / (liked-album ...) for every library item. Every non-final action requires (not (task-completed)), so complete_task is necessarily last. At runtime the number of like calls equals the number of library items missing from the liked lists (the count objects are not API arguments).
